notes: Smuggling and customs: contraband from fences at derelicts sells for 3x in settlement back rooms, if customs does not catch you. Bank (deposit, withdraw), loans (up to 5000, due in 3 days) and a player exchange (ExchangeSell/List/Buy/Cancel) at any market. NPC traders fly between nav points round you in space (firing on them is piracy). Ore deposits in every asteroid belt to mine on a spacewalk. Boards want survey data and hides; the dealer sells the pod and skiff hotrods and the Drover. Fixes: customs, exploration ground sites.
